text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each product shown its own published beam and diffuse, minus the same product with the Erbs split of its own global irradiance. Points of capacity. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. For scale, CAMS leads ERA5 by 3.92 points across the whole record (Figure 1). Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Exploratory. 6 solar farms in Lincolnshire, December 2022 to September 2026.'
text.tspan: Each product shown its own published beam and diffuse, minus the same product with the Erbs split of its own global irradiance.
Points of capacity. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. For scale, CAMS leads ERA5 by 3.92 points across the whole record (Figure 1).
Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Exploratory. 6 solar farms in Lincolnshire, December 2022 to September 2026.
